us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: East Coast storm leaves hundreds of thousands without power
bullets: Heavy rain and wind battered the East Coast after Thanksgiving.
More than 600,000 homes and businesses remained without power Friday morning.
Outages had peaked above 900,000 on Thursday.

articles.title: Republicans reconsider Trump tariffs as Democrats prepare challenge
bullets: Some Republicans are questioning President Trump’s tariff strategy.
Democrats see an opening as they prepare to retake control of Congress.
Canada tariffs and USMCA renewal are emerging as early flashpoints.

articles.title: EPA awaits test results after Iowa lead detonation
bullets: Officials collected samples after a U.S. Army lead detonation in Iowa.
The EPA said test results were expected soon.
Residents had raised safety concerns before and after the operation.

articles.title: Black Friday crowds return despite weeks of online discounts
bullets: Shoppers gathered before sunrise at Macy’s and other stores.
Retailers face a shorter, more stretched-out holiday shopping season.
Adobe reported AI-driven shopping referrals more than doubled from 2025.

articles.title: Reuters summary flags U.S. measles cases across 47 jurisdictions
bullets: The CDC reported 6,039 confirmed measles cases as of November 24.
Cases were spread across 47 U.S. jurisdictions.
The update appeared in Reuters’ U.S. domestic news summary.

articles.title: Zelenskyy urges Washington to increase pressure on Putin
bullets: Ukraine’s president criticized Trump’s description of Putin as “my friend.”
Kyiv is pressing for stronger U.S. pressure on Moscow.
Russia launched nearly 300 aerial attacks a week in November.

articles.title: UN warns hunger risks will deepen in 16 countries
bullets: UN food agencies warned hunger could worsen over six months.
Sudan and Yemen were among countries facing the gravest risks.
War, displacement, fuel costs and aid cuts are key drivers.

articles.title: Houthis report 11 killed in airstrike in Yemen
bullets: Houthi officials said 11 people, including children, were killed.
AP said it could not independently verify the claims.
Saudi coalition officials had no immediate public comment.

articles.title: New Zealand election results leave Luxon short of majority
bullets: Final results showed New Zealand’s ruling coalition short of a majority.
Prime Minister Christopher Luxon needs support from centrist parties.
The result followed the country’s November 7 election.

articles.title: Iran and Algeria expected to discuss gas-producer bloc
bullets: Iran and Algeria were expected to discuss a gas producers’ grouping.
The talks were linked to Algeria’s president visiting Tehran.
The idea resembles an OPEC-style framework for gas exporters.

articles.title: Parliament special session expected to focus on delimitation
bullets: Hindustan Times highlighted a likely Parliament special session agenda.
Delimitation was listed among the key political issues.
The item appeared in HT’s November 27 morning news brief.

articles.title: NDA position improves after opposition defections, HT reports
bullets: HT reported major churn among opposition lawmakers.
Several Trinamool Congress lawmakers reportedly joined another party.
Some Shiv Sena UBT lawmakers reportedly moved to Shiv Sena.

articles.title: India and UAE agree to deepen defence cooperation
bullets: India and the UAE held their 14th JDCC meeting in Abu Dhabi.
Both sides agreed to boost defence co-development and co-production.
The talks took place on November 26, 2026.

articles.title: Congress youth wing challenges India’s online rules in Delhi court
bullets: A court filing dated November 25 was seen by Reuters.
The case challenges rules critics call suppressive of lawful political expression.
The filing was made in the Delhi High Court.

articles.title: Tata power tussle escalates, Reuters-linked report says
bullets: A Reuters-linked report described tensions at India’s largest corporate group.
Tata’s businesses include Jaguar Land Rover and Tetley tea.
The report said the latest development comes amid shakier markets.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Market movers and Wall Street themes

articles.title: U.S. equity funds see biggest outflows in 11 weeks
bullets: Reuters reported heavy weekly outflows from U.S. equity funds.
The week ended November 25 saw the largest withdrawals in nearly three months.
Tech weakness and AI investment concerns weighed on sentiment.

articles.title: Wall Street volatility remains elevated before jobs data
bullets: Reuters said investors are focused on the next monthly jobs report.
AI-related stock volatility has kept markets on edge.
The VIX remained well above its long-term median.

articles.title: AI stock rebound continues into shortened Black Friday session
bullets: U.S. markets reopened for a shortened post-Thanksgiving session.
AI-related shares were in focus after recent sharp swings.
StockTitan tracked premarket movers and market conditions.

articles.title: Wednesday indexes closed mixed before Thanksgiving break
bullets: The S&P 500 slipped 0.25% on Wednesday.
The Nasdaq Composite fell 0.62%.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.33%.

articles.title: Global shares mostly rise ahead of Wall Street reopening
bullets: AP reported broad global market gains before U.S. trading resumed.
Chinese officials signaled stronger stock-market support.
AI-linked buying remained a major global market driver.

articles.title: Retailers count on Black Friday after weeks of early deals
bullets: Black Friday has evolved into a multiweek retail event.
Retailers are balancing holiday demand with cautious consumers.
Salesforce expected deep discounts in clothing, home goods and beauty.

articles.title: Airbus agrees to sell U.S. space business to Cerberus
bullets: Axios reported Airbus agreed to sell its U.S. space business.
Cerberus Capital Management is the buyer.
The item appeared in Axios Pro Rata’s deal roundup.

articles.title: Kraken owner Payward acquires Tribe Capital
bullets: Payward, owner of crypto exchange Kraken, announced the acquisition.
The target is venture firm Tribe Capital.
Axios listed the deal in its corporate venturing roundup.

articles.title: Disney’s ABC sues FCC over broadcast-license order
bullets: ABC and parent Disney sued the FCC in August.
The dispute concerns early license-renewal applications for eight ABC-owned stations.
AP’s business summary highlighted the litigation update.

articles.title: China plans new steps to stabilize capital markets
bullets: Reuters reported China is preparing incremental capital-market policies.
Measures include encouraging listed firms to raise dividends and buybacks.
The plan was cited by Xinhua after a cabinet meeting.

articles.title: Los Angeles schools block Google AI features
bullets: School districts are pushing back against Google’s AI features.
Los Angeles blocked the tools amid classroom concerns.
Some districts are considering dropping Google products without permanent workarounds.

articles.title: Hackers breach U.S. Air Force Cloud One platform, Reuters reports
bullets: Reuters reported a breach of the Air Force’s flagship cloud platform.
U.S. Cyber Command began a damage assessment.
Application updates and migrations were halted, according to the report.

articles.title: SAP investigates suspicious activity but says customer data appears safe
bullets: SAP told Reuters it identified suspicious activity.
The company said it found no evidence of unauthorized customer-data access.
The update came in Reuters’ corporate news feed.

articles.title: U.S. chip rules pressure Chinese AI labs’ model timelines
bullets: Reports said Z.AI’s next flagship model is behind schedule.
Moonshot AI may face longer gaps between flagship releases.
The delays were linked to reduced overseas compute access.

articles.title: Apple removes MiniMax Talkie chatbot after child-safety allegations
bullets: Apple removed MiniMax’s Talkie chatbot from its App Store worldwide.
The move followed reporting on alleged harmful messages to children.
Reuters was cited in AI news summaries about the removal.
